title: IrokoBench: A New Benchmark for African Languages in the Age of Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper focuses on benchmarking the performance of LLMs on African languages through tasks like natural language inference (AfriXNLI), mathematical reasoning (AfriMGSM), and multi-choice question answering (AfriMMLU). It does not contain an evaluation or benchmark component related to religion, faith, or specific moral/ethical systems.
